name: Manding Sunjata epic in Niane’s 1960 edition
description: Manding oral narrators preserve and adapt the Sunjata epic; Djibril Tamsir Niane’s French edition made one version available in print.

impact.note: One printed version of a living Manding epic; widely read and taught in one region and beyond, with some later editions and scholarship following.

events.statement: Niane’s Soundjata, ou l’épopée mandingue was published in 1960.
events.scope: The edition represents one mediated version of a varied oral tradition; its publication date is not the epic’s origin.
